title: The ElevenLabs Voice Library: Find, Save and Use Voices
desc:
The ElevenLabs Voice Library holds over 10,000 community voices. This episode covers the three voice types, how to search by name, voice ID or an audio clip, the sort options and filters, the difference between Use voice and saving to My Voices, how notice periods protect your access, the icons in My Voices, and the fine print: credit multipliers, free plan limits and Live Moderation.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
